risks.name: Loss of Accountability / Attribution
risks.description: Actions, transactions, asset ownership or other relevant activity cannot be reliably attributed to an accountable individual, service or system, impairing traceability, non-repudiation and enforcement.

risks.name: Excessive or Unauthorized Privilege
risks.description: Users, services or systems obtain or retain privileges beyond those required for authorized duties, increasing the ability to access, change, disclose or disrupt protected resources.

risks.name: Unauthorized Privilege Elevation
risks.description: An actor, account, service or process gains privileges beyond its authorized level, enabling access to restricted functions, data or administrative capabilities.

risks.name: Unauthorized Access
risks.description: Individuals, groups, services, devices or processes gain access to Technology Assets, Applications, Services, Data and/or Facilities (TAASDF) without appropriate authorization.

risks.name: Identity Compromise / Impersonation
risks.description: A user, service or machine identity is compromised, spoofed or hijacked, allowing an unauthorized actor to authenticate or operate as a trusted identity.

risks.name: Loss, Theft or Damage of Assets
risks.description: Technology, data, equipment or other organizational assets are lost, stolen, destroyed, damaged or otherwise rendered unavailable for authorized use.

risks.name: Unauthorized Modification / Loss of System Integrity
risks.description: Unauthorized or unintended changes alter the configuration, code, data or state of a Technology Asset, Application and/or Service (TAAS) causing it to operate in an untrusted or unreliable manner.

risks.name: Unauthorized Retention / Inability to Dispose of Data
risks.description: Sensitive and/or regulated data is retained beyond authorized or necessary periods, cannot be reliably located or disposed of, or remains recoverable after intended destruction, creating security, data privacy, legal or discovery exposure.

risks.name: Business / Service Interruption
risks.description: Critical business processes, mission functions and Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) become unavailable, materially degraded or unable to meet required service levels.

risks.name: Data Loss / Integrity Compromise
risks.description: Data is destroyed, unavailable, corrupted, altered or otherwise loses required integrity or recoverability, impairing business, legal or operational use.

risks.name: Reduced Operational Productivity
risks.description: Personnel, systems and/or business processes operate below required efficiency or throughput because necessary Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) are unavailable or degraded.

risks.name: System / Data Compromise (Technical Vector)
risks.description: Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) experience a technical attack vector compromise that results in unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or disruption (e.g., malware, phishing, hacking, etc.).

risks.name: System / Data Compromise (Non-Technical Vector)
risks.description: Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) experience a non-technical attack vector compromise that results in unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or disruption (e.g., social engineering, sabotage, etc.).

risks.name: Revenue Loss
risks.description:
The organization experiences reduced current or future revenue because a control deficiency disrupts operations:
(1) Causes customer loss;
(2) Prevents sales; and/or
(3) Otherwise impairs revenue-generating activity.

risks.name: Contractual Default / Termination
risks.description: The organization breaches, defaults on, loses, terminates or fails to renew a contract because it cannot meet required security, data privacy, compliance, resilience and/or performance obligations.

risks.name: Loss of Competitive Advantage
risks.description:
The organization loses market position, strategic differentiation, intellectual advantage or customer preference because a control deficiency
(1) Exposes data;
(2) Disrupts performance; and/or
(3) Weakens stakeholder confidence.

risks.name: Reputational Harm / Loss of Stakeholder Trust
risks.description:
Customers, partners, regulators, investors, employees or the public lose confidence in the organization, resulting in:
(1) Reputational damage; and/or
(2) Diminished brand value.

risks.name: Regulatory / Legal / Contractual Financial Liability
risks.description: The organization incurs fines, penalties, judgments, remediation, settlements, damages, indemnification costs or other financial liability due to legal, regulatory or contractual noncompliance.

risks.name: Exposure from Unaddressed Vulnerabilities
risks.description: Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) remain exploitable because they are not remediated, mitigated or otherwise addressed, increasing exposure to compromise.

risks.name: System / Service Compromise
risks.description: Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) are compromised, resulting in loss of confidentiality, integrity, availability, authenticity and/or safety.

risks.name: Failure to Achieve Strategic / Mission Objectives
risks.description: A control deficiency materially prevents, delays or degrades the organization's ability to achieve strategic, mission or program objectives.

risks.name: Intellectual Property / Trade Secret Loss
Fraud / Theft / Direct Financial Loss
Loss of Authorization / Certification / License
risks.description: The organization loses or is unable to obtain or maintain an authorization, certification, accreditation, license or other permission required to operate, sell, contract or access a market.

risks.name: Failure to Support Business / Mission Objectives
risks.description: Security, data privacy, compliance or resilience deficiencies prevent Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) from reliably supporting required business operations, mission functions or strategic objectives.

risks.name: Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure
risks.description: Incorrect or incomplete control scoping leaves applicable People, Processes, Technologies, Data and/or Facilities (PPTDF)  without required safeguards, creating unmanaged security, data privacy, compliance and/or resilience exposure.

risks.name: Unperformed / Unowned Control Responsibilities
risks.description: Required security, data privacy, compliance and/or resilience activities are not performed, coordinated or escalated because responsibility or accountability is unclear or unassigned.

risks.name: Uncontrolled Internal Security / Privacy Exposure
risks.description: Internal practices are insufficient to prevent, detect, respond to or recover from security, data privacy, compliance and/or resilience events, leaving organizational operations and assets exposed.

risks.name: Uncontrolled Third-Party Security / Privacy Exposure
risks.description: Weak third-party governance or Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management (C-SCRM) practices leave the organization exposed to security, data privacy, compliance, resilience or dependency risks originating from suppliers and External Service Providers (ESP).

risks.name: Lack of oversight of internal controls
risks.description: Internal control deficiencies, failures or changes remain unidentified or unresolved, allowing risk exposure to persist and reducing the organization's ability to demonstrate due diligence and due care.

risks.name: Lack of oversight of third-party controls
risks.description: Third-party control deficiencies, failures or changes remain unidentified or unresolved, allowing supplier-originated exposure to persist and reducing the organization's ability to demonstrate appropriate Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) oversight.

risks.name: Harm from Illegal, Abusive or Unsafe Content / Conduct
Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care
risks.description: The organization cannot produce defensible evidence that applicable risks, controls and obligations were reasonably identified, implemented, monitored and/or governed.

risks.name: Unreliable Assurance / Decision Information
risks.description:
Executive management, the Board of Directors (BoD), assessors or other stakeholders rely on inaccurate, incomplete or untimely control, risk or compliance information, leading to:
(1) Unsound decisions; and/or
(2) False assurance.

risks.name: Loss of Investigative / Evidentiary Capability
Delayed Containment / Increased Incident Impact
risks.description: An incident is not contained, eradicated, communicated or escalated in a timely and appropriate manner, allowing the scope, duration, cost and/or harm of the incident to increase.

risks.name: Incident Persistence / Recurrence
risks.description: Root causes, persistence mechanisms or affected conditions are not effectively remediated, allowing the incident, vulnerability or compromise to continue or recur.

risks.name: Incident Response / Recovery Cost
risks.description: The organization incurs unplanned investigation, containment, recovery, notification, legal, forensic, restoration and/or other costs associated with managing an incident or loss event.

risks.name: Recovery Failure / Unacceptable Recovery Delay
risks.description: The organization cannot restore critical services, data, facilities or capabilities within required recovery objectives after a disruption.

risks.name: Concentration / Single-Point Dependency Failure
risks.description: Failure of a highly concentrated supplier, technology, facility, region or other dependency causes disproportionate disruption because adequate alternatives or redundancy are unavailable.

risks.name: Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity
risks.description: Malicious, abnormal, unauthorized or otherwise material activity is not detected or recognized in time to prevent or limit harm.

risks.name: Lack of a security-minded workforce
Third-Party Cybersecurity Compromise / Exposure
risks.description: A supplier or External Service Provider (ESP) experiencing a cybersecurity weakness, incident or compromise causes loss of Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability and/or Safety (CIAS) in organizational products, services, data or operations.

risks.name: Third-Party Physical Security Disruption / Exposure
risks.description: A physical security event affecting a supplier's or External Service Provider's (ESP)  facilities, personnel, equipment or other assets disrupts or compromises products, services, data or operations relied upon by the organization.

risks.name: Sub-Tier / Fourth-Party Supply Chain Exposure
risks.description: Risks originating from a supplier's or External Service Provider's (ESP)  own suppliers, subcontractors or dependencies propagate through the supply chain and affect organizational Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability and/or Safety (CIAS), compliance and/or operations.

risks.name: Third-Party Legal / Compliance Exposure
Harm from Unauthorized / Unintended Product or Service Use
risks.description: A product or service is used outside its authorized, intended or approved purpose, creating security, data privacy, safety, legal, operational or financial harm.

risks.name: Third-Party Dependency Failure
risks.description: A critical third-party product, service or capability becomes unavailable, degraded, discontinued or otherwise unable to support required operations, causing business operations disruption.

risks.name: Counterfeit / Non-Conforming Component Impact
risks.description: Counterfeit, substituted, defective or non-conforming products or components cause reliability, security, safety, warranty or operational failures in organizational Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS).

risks.name: AI Output / Decision Integrity Failure
risks.description: An Artificial Intelligence (AI) model produces inaccurate, manipulated, biased, unsafe or otherwise unreliable outputs or decisions that cause dependent controls, users or processes to act incorrectly.

risks.name: AI Data Confidentiality / Integrity / Provenance Loss
risks.description: Training, fine-tuning, embedding, retrieval or inference data is disclosed, altered, contaminated, misattributed or stripped of required provenance, undermining data privacy, security or Artificial Intelligence (AI) reliability.

risks.name: Unauthorized / Harmful Autonomous Action
risks.description: An Artificial Intelligence (AI) agent or autonomous system takes an action outside authorized scope or intended objectives, causing security, data privacy, safety, legal, financial and/or operational harm.

risks.name: Sensitive Data / Compliance Exposure from Unsanctioned AI Use
Unintended or Unsafe Technology Behavior
risks.description: Artificial Intelligence (AI) exhibits emergent, unanticipated or unintended behavior that produces incorrect, unsafe or harmful outcomes or causes dependent controls and processes to operate outside intended boundaries.

risks.name: AI Bias / Discriminatory Outcome
risks.description: Artificial Intelligence (AI)-supported decisions or outputs produce unjustified, systematically biased or discriminatory outcomes that create legal, ethical, reputational or individual harm.

risks.name: OT Safety / Process Availability Failure
risks.description:
Failure or compromise of Operational Technology (OT) or Industrial Control System (ICS) functions causes:
(1) Loss or degradation of safety functions;
(2) Physical-process availability; and/or
(3)  Equipment integrity / unsafe operating conditions.

risks.name: Long-Term Confidentiality Loss from Cryptographic Obsolescence
risks.description: Sensitive and/or regulated data requiring long confidentiality lifetimes becomes susceptible to Harvest Now, Decrypt Later (HNDL) collection and future decryption.

risks.name: Loss of Confidentiality
risks.description:
Sensitive and/or regulated data is disclosed or made accessible to unauthorized:
(1) Individuals;
(2) Entities; and/or
(3) Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS).

risks.name: Loss of Data Integrity
risks.description: Data is altered, corrupted, fabricated, deleted or otherwise changed without authorization or reliable detection, causing it to become untrustworthy for its intended use.

risks.name: Loss of Data / Service Availability
risks.description: Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) are unavailable or inaccessible when required to support authorized business or mission needs.

risks.name: Loss of Authenticity / Provenance
Privacy Harm / Unauthorized Processing
Injury / Loss of Life
risks.description:
A control deficiency contributes to unsafe conditions that cause or materially increase the likelihood of:
(1) Human injury;
(2) Illness; and/or
(3) Loss of life.

risks.name: Physical / Environmental Damage
Loss of Critical Knowledge / Capability
risks.description: The organization loses essential knowledge, skills, authority or operational capability because critical personnel are unavailable, depart or cannot perform required duties.
